(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium, wherein the non-destructive medium includes, but is not limited to, a solution that retains viability; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with a cell wall degrading enzyme, but not limited to VISCOZYME@.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos or embryos in a quiescent state.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The method of claim 1, further comprising storing the one or more embryos in a quiescent state prior to step (c) or (d).

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping performed using techniques selected from the group consisting of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads, or combinations thereof.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The method of claim 1 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype analyzed from the molecular analysis. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated using techniques chosen from a range of automation processes.
